recipe.visualDefinition: A high-energy, youthful collage featuring four central figures in a row, styled with a 'scrapbook' aesthetic. The composition uses white sticker-like outlines around the subjects, set against a textured, pale yellow background with subtle starburst patterns and paper fold creases. The typography is bold, layered, and multi-colored, positioned at the top center to anchor the design.
coreVisualRelationships: Sticker-cut subjects against a textured, folded paper background
Bold, heavy-stroked display type layered over a guitar pick graphic
A color gradient transition from warm yellow to cool green across the bottom subjects
Subtle starburst and star motifs reinforcing a 'pop star' theme
coreInvariants: White border 'sticker' effect around all human subjects
Visible paper fold lines and distressed texture
Heavy black outlines on all primary text elements
Halftone dot patterns integrated into the background and shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four subjects arranged horizontally across the lower two-thirds, slightly overlapping, with the central two figures slightly larger.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-colored title block at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top center title, moves down to the faces of the subjects, and settles on the textured background details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated at the top corners and between the title and the subjects' heads, filled with starburst patterns.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant green and golden yellow (title text and lower gradient)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text and lower gradients contrasted against a desaturated, vintage-wash background.

letterConstructionRules: Inner color gradients (yellow to orange or green to dark green)
Slightly irregular baseline for a 'tossed' look
characterSpecificRedesigns: The number '2' is placed inside a green guitar pick shape
Secondary text is set in a heavy slab-serif with a horizontal underline bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Stacked variations of heavy weights, using color and graphic containers (guitar pick) to differentiate levels.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and verticality for the main title.
Matches the slab-serif feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a textured pale yellow background with visible paper fold creases and a subtle starburst pattern. Place four youthful figures in a row, each with a thick white 'sticker-cut' outline. Apply a green-to-transparent gradient overlay at the bottom right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, stacked uppercase text at the top center. Use extra-bold sans-serif for the main words with thick black outlines and yellow/green gradients. Place a numeric character inside a green guitar pick shape. Add a slab-serif subtitle below with horizontal bars.

verificationChecks: Are the subjects outlined in white like stickers?
Is the paper texture and fold line visible?
Does the text have a heavy black stroke?
Is the color palette consistent with yellow, green, and black?

adjustableVariables: Color of the guitar pick graphic
Number of subjects in the row
postGenerationChecks: Check for white sticker borders around all subjects
Ensure text is legible despite heavy outlines
Verify the presence of paper fold textures
Confirm the starburst background elements are subtle
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Sticker-Cut Subjects] + [Textured Folded Paper Background] + [Heavy Outlined Stacked Type] + [Pop-Rock Color Palette] to create a youthful promotional collage.
